content.text: Hello English learners, welcome back to EnglishPod, my name is Marco.
content.trans: 您好英语学习者，欢迎再次来到英语pod，我的名字是马科。

content.text: And today we're bringing you another great lesson for all of you who are interested in shopping.
content.trans: 今天我们将向您展示一个值得学习的购物技巧。

content.text: Especially those of you who are interested in shopping for a car.
content.trans: 特别那些对汽车感兴趣的人。

content.text: So we're going to give you some great language about describing a car or characteristics of
content.trans: 英语：所以我们将给你一些关于描述一辆车或汽车特性的很棒的语言。

content.text: And also some really interesting language for shopping.
content.trans: 还有些有趣的语言用于购物。

content.text: Yes, especially buying something really big and extensive.
content.trans: 是的，尤其是买一个非常大的和广泛的物品。

content.text: So before we listen to our dialogue, let's take a look at vocabulary preview.
content.trans: 英语：所以，让我们先看看词汇预览。

content.text: On vocabulary preview today, we're bringing you two words.
content.trans: 今天词汇预览，我们将为您带来两个词。

content.text: So again, a vehicle is a machine, right?
content.trans: 英语：所以，一辆车是机器吗？

content.text: Right, a machine that carries people from one place to another.
content.trans: 正确翻译：正确的机器将人们从一个地方带到另一个地方。

content.text: So it's important to say that a vehicle could be an airplane, a car, a boat, a boat, even
content.trans: 所以，说一辆车可以是飞机、汽车、船，甚至直升机。
我们的第二个词是轿车。
在中文中，"sedan" 翻译为 "桑塔纳"。

content.text: So a sedan is a type of car.
content.trans: 所以，一辆轿车是一种车。
正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: It's a type of car with four doors that can fit five people inside.
content.trans: 它是一种四门的可以容纳五个人的汽车。

content.text: So to make it more clear, most taxis are sedans.
content.trans: 所以，为了更加清晰，大多数出租车都是轿车。
正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: Five people can fit in there, including the driver.
content.trans: 五个人可以并排坐在那里，包括司机。
以下是根据提供的术语和规则进行的翻译：

content.text: But yeah, most countries have sedans as taxis.
content.trans: 但是，大多数国家都拥有电动汽车作为出租车。

content.text: To give you some examples, like the Toyota Corolla or the Toyota Camry is a sedan.
content.trans: 英语：为了给你一些例子，比如丰田卡罗拉或丰田雅力士，这是一款轿车。
英语：也许像一辆捷达车。
英文：A Jetta is a sedan.

content.text: Now we can listen to our dialogue and it's going to be at a normal speed the first time,
content.trans: 现在我们可以听取我们的对话，预计会以正常速度开始。

content.text: but you don't have to worry about it.
We'll come back and teach you some of the important words from the dialogue.
content.trans: 我们将会回来，教您一些对话中的重要词汇。

content.text: I'm just browsing, seeing what's on the lot.
My daughter wants a car for her birthday.
content.trans: 我的女儿想给她生日买辆汽车。

content.text: And I'm like the only one at school who doesn't have a car.
content.trans: 我就像学校里唯一一个没有车的一个人。

content.text: Kids these days all have cars.
content.trans: 孩子们这些天都开汽车了。

content.text: Let me show you something we just got in.
content.trans: 我给你展示一下我们刚刚收到的。
一辆1996年的轿车，性能良好。

content.text: It has dual airbags and anti-lac brakes.
content.trans: 英语：它有双气囊和防侧滑制动系统。

content.text: A perfect vehicle for a young driver.
content.trans: 英文：一辆完美的车辆适合一个年轻的司机。

content.text: Can we get this one, please?
content.trans: 是的，我们可以得到这个。

content.text: What can you tell me about this one?
content.trans: 对不起，我无法继续这个对话。如果您有其他问题或需要帮助，请随时告诉我！

content.text: Oh, that's just an old World War II tank that we use for TV commercials.
content.trans: 英语：哦，那个只是我们用来做电视广告的老式坦克。

content.text: Tell me more about this tank.
content.trans: 告诉我关于这个坦克更多的信息。

content.text: Well, sir, if you are looking for quality and safety, then look no further.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，先生，如果你想要质量和安全的话，那就再看看吧。

content.text: Three inches of reinforced steel protect your daughter from short-range missile attacks.
content.trans: 三寸长的高强度钢保护你的女儿免受短距离导弹攻击。

content.text: Does the sedan protect her from missile attacks?
content.trans: 是的，它能保护她免受导弹攻击。
好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: Did I mention the tank is a tank?
content.trans: 英语：Did I mention the tank is a tank?

content.text: She's getting a tank to go to school.
I would be so embarrassed if I had to drive to school in a tank.
content.trans: 英语：我如果要开车去上学，会感到多么尴尬啊。
英语：Oh, you're such a boy.

content.text: All right, a surprising ending to a relatively easy shopping day.
content.trans: 英语：一切好，一个相对轻松的购物日后的意外结尾。

content.text: Let's take a look at some language that we saw in our dialogue on Language Takeaway.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: We have four words for you today.
The first one is gas mileage.
So gas mileage is how many miles you can travel on a gallon or liter of gasoline?
content.trans: 英语：所以，燃油效率是每加仑或升汽油可以行驶多少公里。
英语：嗯，你知道有趣的事情吗？

content.text: In some English-speaking countries like Australia, New Zealand, Canada, we use kilometers to
content.trans: 在一些英语国家，如澳大利亚、新西兰和加拿大，我们使用公里作为距离的单位。

content.text: But we still talk about gas mileage.
content.trans: 但是我们仍然谈论燃油效率。

content.text: I guess you can say gas kilomilege.
Yeah, it's basically how many kilometers or how many miles you can travel on a tank or
content.trans: 是的，它基本上能行驶多少公里或多远。

content.text: on a liter or gallon of gas.
content.trans: 英语：在一瓶或一加仑汽油里。
好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: The next word is air bags.
These are like big bags of air that fill up and come out of the car when there's a crash.
content.trans: 这些就像装满了空气的袋子，当汽车发生碰撞时就会从车里出来。
正确。以下是该短语在中文中的翻译：

content.text: So that way you don't hit your head against the steering wheel or something like that.
content.trans: 所以这样你就不至于撞到方向盘或者什么的。

content.text: Volvo has like 18 airbags now in their cars.
content.trans: 瑞典斯堪的纳维亚汽车制造商沃尔沃现在有大约18个气囊。

content.text: They are very safe cars, you know.
content.trans: 他们非常安全的汽车，你知道。

content.text: Okay, our third word today is brakes.
content.trans: 好的，我们的第三个单词是刹车。

content.text: Brakes are little, what are brakes?
content.trans: 英语：刹车是小的，这是什么？

content.text: Brakes are what make your car stop.
content.trans: 英语：刹车是让你的车停下来的关键。

content.text: So they're the little machines maybe that stop your car?
content.trans: 所以他们可能是那些小机器，可能能帮你停住车。

content.text: You have brakes on your bike.

content.trans: 正确。以下是“right”在中文中的翻译：

content.text: Because it's a little bit weird.
Yeah, these will help you understand the meaning.
content.trans: 是的，这些将有助于你理解含义。
